laravel_adaptation.authorization_contract: trusted FrontendContext + tenant.view; destination is the already-terminal AboutBuildRouteServiceProvider route whose controller independently authorizes tenant.view and rejects a route tenant that differs from active TenantContext
laravel_adaptation.network_request: read-only browser navigation GET to the protected Laravel route
laravel_adaptation.fail_closed_behavior: control is absent without tenant.view; guest, missing-permission and foreign-tenant requests are rejected by the backend instead of rendering build metadata

runtime_path: authenticated tenant bootstrap obtains FrontendContext under auth + tenant.context and tenant.view
CurrentUserSiteDetailsControl composes CurrentUserBuildInformationControl inside the current-user action group
CurrentUserBuildInformationControl requires trusted tenant.view permission and derives /tenants/{encoded tenant}/about-build exclusively from FrontendContext.tenant.slug
AboutBuildRouteServiceProvider serves /tenants/{tenant}/about-build under web + auth + tenant.context
AboutBuildReadController independently authorizes tenant.view and aborts 404 when the route slug differs from active TenantContext
BuildInformationReadService supplies safe build metadata; the selected operation performs no mutation, queueing, caching, scheduling, connector call, AI/provider call or success fabrication

security_boundary.auth_session: destination is protected by Laravel web session auth and tenant.context middleware
security_boundary.active_tenant_resolution: navigation derives the encoded destination from server-provided FrontendContext tenant; backend compares route tenant with active TenantContext
security_boundary.permission_checks: UI fails closed unless tenant.view is advertised; AboutBuildReadController independently re-authorizes tenant.view
security_boundary.foreign_tenant_rejection: focused HTTP acceptance proves an authenticated alpha member receives 404 for /tenants/foreign/about-build
security_boundary.direct_id_rejection: not applicable: selected control accepts no resource identifier
security_boundary.validation: selected operation sends no user payload
security_boundary.csrf: not applicable: selected operation is GET/read-only and has no persistence mutation
security_boundary.server_derived_identity_and_ownership: authenticated user and tenant membership are server resolved; the control cannot supply an alternate user or direct object owner
security_boundary.secret_non_exposure: focused acceptance verifies live safe build fields and rejects APP_KEY, DB_PASSWORD and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY labels from rendered output
security_boundary.authoritative_persistence_reread: not applicable because there is no persistence mutation or persisted-success claim
security_boundary.idempotency_retry_cancellation: not applicable to deterministic read-only navigation
security_boundary.truthful_success: the control only navigates; metadata is shown only after the protected controller succeeds
security_boundary.fail_closed: missing permission, auth, membership or active-tenant match removes or rejects the path rather than synthesizing build data
